_note: Config for ingest/sync_events.py. sig_title_patterns: SIG key (as sig_display in channel_manifest) -> substring of a calendar event title. series_title_patterns: non-SIG recurring series. extra_aliases: history event id -> extra phrasings people use. significance: history event id -> 'major' (default) | 'ordinary'. Edit and rerun the script; nothing else to change. archive_namespace: history event id -> Pinecone namespace holding its programme (lets 'what's on today' scope to it while the event runs). windows: event id -> {lead_days, tail_days} overriding the worker defaults (14 / 3). exclusive: history event ids whose programme is ingested into their own namespace (archive_namespace); a question that names one is answered from that namespace alone (worker eventScope). Adding the next symposium = add it to events.json, set archive_namespace + exclusive here.
